releaseNotes: CodeWave v1.3.4: Enhanced Lossless & Hi-Res explainer popup with plain-English fidelity breakdowns and resolution tier ladder, eliminated app icon black borders and double squircles with full-bleed adaptive framing, upgraded miniplayer with prominent high-contrast 3.5dp progress bar and leading glow pulse, and completely overhauled the Equalizer into a clean, unique VS Code-inspired workstation with zero horizontal scrolling for sliders and presets and a live parametric frequency curve.
